page.intro: Installed components (Jahia and modules) for which the Jahia Store publishes updates that fix security issues.
page.error: The security report could not be loaded.
page.notRefreshed: A check ran less than 30 seconds ago: the report is unchanged.
page.refreshError: The check could not be run.
page.empty: No known security update for this Jahia.
page.filteredEmpty: No Jahia advisory concerns this Jahia. Select "All" to see the reports of module owners.

status.NOT_CHECKED: No check has run yet. The first check runs about one minute after startup; use "Check now" to run it immediately.
status.DISABLED: The security updates check is disabled by configuration.
status.PARTIAL: Some stores could not be checked: this list may be incomplete.
status.UNAVAILABLE: Security feed unavailable: it cannot be said whether this Jahia needs security updates.

errors.title: Problems met during the last check

errorKind.NOT_PUBLISHED: Store does not publish security data

filter.all: All, including reports by module owners

table.caption: Components with security updates, most severe first

banner.label: Security updates
banner.message: Security updates of {{threshold}} concern this Jahia: {{count}}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Changes are saved in the configuration org.jahia.community.securityupdates (karaf/etc) and apply at once.

enabled.label: Check the stores for security updates
enabled.help: When unchecked, no store is checked and this page says the check is disabled.

refreshIntervalHours.label: Hours between two checks
refreshIntervalHours.help: A whole number from 1 to 720. The first check runs about one minute after a change.

useForgeSettings.label: Use the stores of the module manager
useForgeSettings.help: Checks the stores configured in Manage modules, with their credentials.

defaultStoreUrl.label: Default store URL
defaultStoreUrl.help: Used when no store is configured in the module manager. An absolute http or https URL, or empty for none.

extraFeedUrls.label: Additional security feed URLs
extraFeedUrls.help: Full URLs of security feeds, separated by commas. Absolute http or https URLs, without credentials.

bannerEnabled.label: Show the notice
bannerEnabled.help: Shows a notice on every page of the Jahia UI to users who can manage modules.

bannerMinimumSeverity.label: Lowest severity counted by the notice
bannerMinimumSeverity.help: Findings below this severity do not count.

bannerIncludeOwnerReports.label: Count the reports of module owners
bannerIncludeOwnerReports.help: When unchecked, only Jahia advisories count.

bannerBackgroundColor.label: Notice background colour (hex)
bannerBackgroundColor.help: #RRGGBB. The contrast ratio with the text colour must be at least 7:1.

bannerTextColor.label: Notice text colour (hex)
bannerTextColor.help: #RRGGBB. Also used for the link, the button and the focus ring.

bannerDismissPolicy.label: After the notice is dismissed
bannerDismissPolicy.help: Except with "Cannot be dismissed", the notice comes back when other components are concerned.

bannerDismissHours.label: Hours the notice stays hidden
bannerDismissHours.help: A whole number from 1 to 720, used by "For a number of hours".

dismiss.SESSION: Hidden until the browser session ends
dismiss.HOURS: Hidden for a number of hours
dismiss.UNTIL_CHANGE: Hidden until other components are concerned

preview.title: Preview
preview.fail: Below the 7:1 minimum: this pair cannot be saved.
preview.invalid: Enter two #RRGGBB colours to see the contrast ratio.

settings.invalid: Some settings are not valid: nothing was saved. See the fields marked with an error.

errors.INVALID_URL: Enter absolute http or https URLs, without credentials, query or fragment.
errors.INVALID_VALUE: Choose one of the proposed values.
errors.INVALID_COLOR: Enter a colour as #RRGGBB, for example #0B3D91.
errors.LOW_CONTRAST: The contrast ratio of the two colours is {{ratio}}:1; at least 7:1 is required.
errors.WRITE_FAILED: The settings could not be saved. See the Jahia log.

suggest.none: No single colour change reaches 7:1 with these colours. The default colours do.
suggest.appliedText: Text colour {{value}} applied. Save the settings to keep it.
suggest.appliedBackground: Background colour {{value}} applied. Save the settings to keep it.
suggest.appliedDefaults: Default colours applied. Save the settings to keep them.
